method: Sequential ffprobe metadata then ffmpeg single-thread decode. Process tree restricted to one allowed logical processor, BelowNormal priority. No playback or source changes. Silence threshold -50 dBFS for >=50 ms; LUFS is gated EBU R128, not directly comparable across all event lengths. Boundary is decoded MP3 sample jump, not proof of audible click or seamless browser looping. None means unavailable or zero amplitude.
